implementation: Adapted stable v5 parser and validator; XMLBuilder delegates to vfast-xml-builder. CLI and experimental v6 sources excluded.
changes: All six direct dependencies use VPM packages
Reusable per-parser engine, compiled stop expressions, immutable option snapshots, document cleanup and reentry protection
Exact element depth bounds and validated entity limits; one self-closing transform; safe callback-produced names and attributes
Repeatable regex filters, grouped predicates, XML declaration version independent of output transforms, correct XML Name validation
Stricter validator for roots, attributes, declarations and references; linear malformed-whitespace handling and sliced text scans
Explicit string/Uint8Array inputs, safe entity registration, CJS/ESM exports and self-contained declarations
